main.description: A segment's trail reports the viewer may see (segments/trail-reports), newest first by when the AppView first indexed them. Leaves out reports in a block with the viewer either way, by an author the viewer mutes, and those labelled !hide or !takedown (on the record or its author) unless the viewer wrote them.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The segment isn't indexed, or isn't served (as for getSegment).
